original_idea.body:
# Importing Aviation Safety Management System (SMS) Design to AI Cyber Governance Program Design

**Problem:** Aviation's Safety Management Systems (SMS) provide a mature four-component framework (safety policy, safety risk management, safety assurance, safety promotion) for systematic safety governance in high-risk technology.

**Direction:** Map ICAO SMS components onto AI cyber governance. For each SMS component, identify the AI lab governance equivalent and assess maturity. Produce an SMS-based maturity model for AI cyber governance. Score 3 labs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google DeepMind) against the maturity model.

**Why it matters:** SMS is an internationally standardized governance framework that has substantially reduced aviation accident rates. Its principled importation into AI could rapidly accelerate governance maturity.

**Relevant context:** ICAO SMS framework; Bengio et al. 2026 governance gap; Anthropic RSP; OpenAI Preparedness Framework.
